1	# Rooms for direct message chats between users. These act as a singleton, so a single set of users will
     2	# always refer to the same direct room.
     3	class Rooms::Direct < Room
     4	  class << self
     5	    def find_or_create_for(users)
     6	      find_for(users) || create_for({}, users: users)
     7	    end
     8	
     9	    private
    10	      # FIXME: Find a more performant algorithm that won't be a problem on accounts with 10K+ direct rooms,
    11	      # which could be to store the membership id list as a hash on the room, and use that for lookup.
    12	      def find_for(users)
    13	        all.joins(:users).detect do |room|
    14	          Set.new(room.user_ids) == Set.new(users.pluck(:id))
    15	        end
    16	      end
    17	  end
    18	
    19	  def default_involvement
    20	    "everything"
    21	  end
    22	end
    23	class Room < ApplicationRecord
    24	  has_many :memberships, dependent: :delete_all do
    25	    def grant_to(users)
    26	      room = proxy_association.owner
    27	      Membership.insert_all(Array(users).collect { |user| { room_id: room.id, user_id: user.id, involvement: room.default_involvement } })
    28	    end
    29	
    30	    def revoke_from(users)
    31	      destroy_by user: users
    32	    end
    33	
    34	    def revise(granted: [], revoked: [])
    35	      transaction do
    36	        grant_to(granted) if granted.present?
    37	        revoke_from(revoked) if revoked.present?
    38	      end
    39	    end
    40	  end
    41	
    42	  has_many :users, through: :memberships
    43	  has_many :messages, dependent: :destroy
    44	
    45	  belongs_to :creator, class_name: "User", default: -> { Current.user }
    46	
    47	  validate :direct_rooms_keep_their_type, on: :update
    48	
    49	  scope :opens,           -> { where(type: "Rooms::Open") }
    50	  scope :closeds,         -> { where(type: "Rooms::Closed") }
    51	  scope :directs,         -> { where(type: "Rooms::Direct") }
    52	  scope :without_directs, -> { where.not(type: "Rooms::Direct") }
    53	
    54	  scope :ordered, -> { order("LOWER(name)") }
    55	
    56	  class << self
    57	    def create_for(attributes, users:)
    58	      transaction do
    59	        create!(attributes).tap do |room|
    60	          room.memberships.grant_to users
    61	        end
    62	      end
    63	    end
    64	
    65	    def original
    66	      order(:created_at).first
    67	    end
    68	  end
    69	
    70	  def receive(message)
    71	    unread_memberships(message)
    72	    push_later(message)
    73	  end
    74	
    75	  def open?
    76	    is_a?(Rooms::Open)
    77	  end
    78	
    79	  def closed?
    80	    is_a?(Rooms::Closed)
    81	  end
    82	
    83	  def direct?
    84	    is_a?(Rooms::Direct)
    85	  end
    86	
    87	  def default_involvement
    88	    "mentions"
    89	  end
    90	
    91	  private
    92	    # Open and closed rooms convert into each other freely. A direct room can't become
    93	    # either: its participants agreed to a private conversation, not to one whose
    94	    # audience someone else gets to widen afterwards.
    95	    def direct_rooms_keep_their_type
    96	      if type_changed? && type_was == "Rooms::Direct"
    97	        errors.add :type, "can't be changed for a direct room"
    98	      end
    99	    end
   100	
   101	    def unread_memberships(message)
   102	      memberships.visible.disconnected.where.not(user: message.creator).update_all(unread_at: message.created_at, updated_at: Time.current)
   103	    end
   104	
   105	    def push_later(message)
   106	      Room::PushMessageJob.perform_later(self, message)
   107	    end
   108	end
   109	class RoomsController < ApplicationController
   110	  before_action :set_room, only: %i[ show destroy ]
   111	  before_action :ensure_can_administer, only: %i[ destroy ]
   112	  before_action :remember_last_room_visited, only: :show
   113	
   114	  def index
   115	    redirect_to room_url(Current.user.rooms.last)
   116	  end
   117	
   118	  def show
   119	    @messages = find_messages
   120	  end
   121	
   122	  def destroy
   123	    @room.destroy
   124	
   125	    broadcast_remove_room
   126	    redirect_to root_url
   127	  end
   128	
   129	  private
   130	    def set_room
   131	      if room = room_scope.find_by(id: params[:room_id] || params[:id])
   132	        @room = room
   133	      else
   134	        redirect_to root_url, alert: "Room not found or inaccessible"
   135	      end
   136	    end
   137	
   138	    # Subclasses narrow this to the room types they're allowed to act on, so that one
   139	    # room namespace can't be used to reach another's rooms.
   140	    def room_scope
   141	      Current.user.rooms
   142	    end
   143	
   144	    def ensure_can_administer
   145	      head :forbidden unless Current.user.can_administer?(@room)
   146	    end
   147	
   148	    def ensure_permission_to_create_rooms
   149	      if Current.account.settings.restrict_room_creation_to_administrators? && !Current.user.administrator?
   150	        head :forbidden
   151	      end
   152	    end
   153	
   154	    def find_messages
   155	      messages = @room.messages.with_creator.with_attachment_details.with_boosts
   156	
   157	      if show_first_message = messages.find_by(id: params[:message_id])
   158	        @messages = messages.page_around(show_first_message)
   159	      else
   160	        @messages = messages.last_page
   161	      end
   162	    end
   163	
   164	    def room_params
   165	      params.require(:room).permit(:name)
   166	    end
   167	
   168	    def broadcast_remove_room
   169	      broadcast_remove_to :rooms, target: [ @room, :list ]
   170	    end
   171	end

1	class Rooms::OpensController < RoomsController
     2	  before_action :set_room, only: %i[ show edit update ]
     3	  before_action :ensure_can_administer, only: %i[ update ]
     4	  before_action :remember_last_room_visited, only: :show
     5	  before_action :force_room_type, only: %i[ edit update ]
     6	  before_action :ensure_permission_to_create_rooms, only: %i[ new create ]
     7	
     8	  DEFAULT_ROOM_NAME = "New room"
     9	
    10	  def show
    11	    redirect_to room_url(@room)
    12	  end
    13	
    14	  def new
    15	    @room = Rooms::Open.new(name: DEFAULT_ROOM_NAME)
    16	    @users = User.active.ordered
    17	  end
    18	
    19	  def create
    20	    room = Rooms::Open.create_for(room_params, users: Current.user)
    21	
    22	    broadcast_create_room(room)
    23	    redirect_to room_url(room)
    24	  end
    25	
    26	  def edit
    27	    @users = User.active.ordered
    28	  end
    29	
    30	  def update
    31	    @room.update! room_params
    32	
    33	    broadcast_update_room
    34	    redirect_to room_url(@room)
    35	  end
    36	
    37	  private
    38	    # Allows us to edit a closed room and turn it into an open one on saving.
    39	    def force_room_type
    40	      @room = @room.becomes!(Rooms::Open)
    41	    end
    42	
    43	    # Open and closed rooms convert into each other, so both are in reach here. Direct
    44	    # rooms never are: promoting one would republish its history to the whole account.
    45	    def room_scope
    46	      Current.user.rooms.without_directs
    47	    end
    48	
    49	    def broadcast_create_room(room)
    50	      broadcast_prepend_to :rooms, target: :shared_rooms, partial: "users/sidebars/rooms/shared", locals: { room: room }
    51	    end
    52	
    53	    def broadcast_update_room
    54	      broadcast_replace_to :rooms, target: [ @room, :list ], partial: "users/sidebars/rooms/shared", locals: { room: @room }
    55	    end
    56	end
    57	class Rooms::ClosedsController < RoomsController
    58	  before_action :set_room, only: %i[ show edit update ]
    59	  before_action :ensure_can_administer, only: %i[ update ]
    60	  before_action :remember_last_room_visited, only: :show
    61	  before_action :force_room_type, only: %i[ edit update ]
    62	  before_action :ensure_permission_to_create_rooms, only: %i[ new create ]
    63	
    64	  DEFAULT_ROOM_NAME = "New room"
    65	
    66	  def show
    67	    redirect_to room_url(@room)
    68	  end
    69	
    70	  def new
    71	    @room  = Rooms::Closed.new(name: DEFAULT_ROOM_NAME)
    72	    @users = User.active.ordered
    73	  end
    74	
    75	  def create
    76	    room = Rooms::Closed.create_for(room_params, users: grantees)
    77	
    78	    broadcast_create_room(room)
    79	    redirect_to room_url(room)
    80	  end
    81	
    82	  def edit
    83	    selected_user_ids = @room.users.pluck(:id)
    84	    @selected_users, @unselected_users = User.active.ordered.partition { |user| selected_user_ids.include?(user.id) }
    85	  end
    86	
    87	  def update
    88	    @room.update! room_params
    89	    @room.memberships.revise(granted: grantees, revoked: revokees)
    90	
    91	    broadcast_update_room
    92	    redirect_to room_url(@room)
    93	  end
    94	
    95	  private
    96	    # Allows us to edit an open room and turn it into a closed one on saving.
    97	    def force_room_type
    98	      @room = @room.becomes!(Rooms::Closed)
    99	    end
   100	
   101	    # Open and closed rooms convert into each other, so both are in reach here. Direct
   102	    # rooms never are: converting one would let its creator revise who's in it.
   103	    def room_scope
   104	      Current.user.rooms.without_directs
   105	    end
   106	
   107	    def grantees
   108	      User.where(id: grantee_ids)
   109	    end
   110	
   111	    def revokees
   112	      @room.users.where.not(id: grantee_ids)
   113	    end
   114	
   115	    def grantee_ids
   116	      params.fetch(:user_ids, [])
   117	    end
   118	
   119	    def broadcast_create_room(room)
   120	      each_user_and_html_for(room) do |user, html|
   121	        broadcast_prepend_to user, :rooms, target: :shared_rooms, html: html
   122	      end
   123	    end
   124	
   125	    def broadcast_update_room
   126	      each_user_and_html_for(@room) do |user, html|
   127	        broadcast_replace_to user, :rooms, target: [ @room, :list ], html: html
   128	      end
   129	    end
   130	
   131	    def each_user_and_html_for(room)
   132	      # Optimization to avoid rendering the same partial for every user
   133	      html = render_to_string(partial: "users/sidebars/rooms/shared", locals: { room: room })
   134	
   135	      room.users.each { |user| yield user, html }
   136	    end
   137	end
   138	class Rooms::DirectsController < RoomsController
   139	  before_action :set_room, only: %i[ edit destroy ]
   140	  def new
   141	    @room = Rooms::Direct.new
   142	  end
   143	
   144	  def create
   145	    room = Rooms::Direct.find_or_create_for(selected_users)
   146	
   147	    broadcast_create_room(room)
   148	    redirect_to room_url(room)
   149	  end
   150	
   151	  def edit
   152	  end
   153	
   154	  private
   155	    def selected_users
   156	      User.where(id: selected_users_ids.including(Current.user.id))
   157	    end
   158	
   159	    def selected_users_ids
   160	      params.fetch(:user_ids, [])
   161	    end
   162	
   163	    def broadcast_create_room(room)
   164	      room.memberships.each do |membership|
   165	        membership.broadcast_prepend_to membership.user, :rooms, target: :direct_rooms, partial: "users/sidebars/rooms/direct"
   166	      end
   167	    end
   168	
   169	    # All users in a direct room can administer it. Only direct rooms, though: this
   170	    # relaxation is why room_scope below has to keep every other type out of reach.
   171	    def ensure_can_administer
   172	      true
   173	    end
   174	
   175	    def room_scope
   176	      Current.user.rooms.directs
   177	    end
   178	end
   179	# Rooms open to all users on the account. When a new user is added to the account, they're automatically granted membership.
   180	class Rooms::Open < Room
   181	  after_save_commit :grant_access_to_all_users
   182	
   183	  private
   184	    def grant_access_to_all_users
   185	      memberships.grant_to(User.active) if type_previously_changed?(to: "Rooms::Open")
   186	    end
   187	end
   188	# Rooms where only a subset of all users on the account have been explicited granted membership.
   189	class Rooms::Closed < Room
   190	end
